source_observation.wp715_contract: VoicePacketCortex.close_session accepts an explicit close turn_id and records it on SESSION_CLOSE independently of the output packets' turn_id.
source_observation.wp715_regression_shape: Accepted WP715 tests include completed output on turn-0 followed by close_session(turn_id=turn-close).
source_observation.wp717_current_guard: validate_completed_heard_result rejects unless close_event.turn_id equals HeardResultPayload.turn_id.
source_observation.risk: A valid accepted WP715 session can therefore be rejected by WP717 even when session identity, VoiceOutcome, fully-heard output set, result digest and SESSION_CLOSE packet inventory are exact. This is integration incompatibility, not evidence of a bad VoiceOutcome.

minimal_counterexample.expected: ACCEPT when exact session/outcome/result/output inventory all bind and close turn remains on same causal voice session

required_discriminator: Add a WP717 regression that reproduces accepted WP715 semantics: queue/complete output on turn-0, derive the exact heard-result identity, close the same VoiceSessionCapsule with turn_id=turn-close, and require validate_completed_heard_result/bind_completed_reentry to accept. Keep rejecting wrong session ids, wrong result digests, omitted/duplicated/reordered packet inventory and non-SESSION_CLOSE events. Do not weaken packet inventory or VoiceOutcome binding.
repair_direction: Do not require close_event.turn_id == heard_result.turn_id. Treat close_event.turn_id as the close-transition turn and bind it through the exact VoiceSessionCapsule/session_id plus exact SESSION_CLOSE packet inventory; the heard-result turn remains derived from the ordered output packets. If an explicit causal relation between close turn and output turn is required, add a typed relation rather than equality that contradicts accepted WP715 behavior.
next_exact_action: WP717 mutation owner should absorb this as a repository regression before repository acceptance, then retain exact zero runtime credit until the repaired exact subject is executed on the admitted VPS route.
